structure.title: Academic structure
structure.intro: Stages, courses, groups, subgroups and subjects of the selected academic year.
structure.caption: Stages of the academic year

empty.title: This academic year has no stages
empty.text: Create the first stage to start defining the structure.

noActive.title: There is no active academic year

group.title: Group
group.chooseSubjects: Subjects of the course that this group takes

form.description: Required fields are marked. The academic year and the parent item cannot be changed afterwards.
form.positionHint: Optional. If left empty, it goes last.

errors.defaultLocaleRequired: The name in the school's default language is missing.

level.title: Delete stage {code}
level.description: The stage is deleted from the academic year. It cannot be deleted if it has courses.

course.title: Delete course {code}
course.description: The course is deleted from the academic year. It cannot be deleted if it has groups or subjects.

group.title: Delete group {code}
group.description: The group is deleted. It cannot be deleted if it has subgroups or assigned subjects.

subgroup.title: Delete subgroup {code}
subgroup.description: The subgroup is deleted from the group.

subject.title: Delete subject {code}
subject.description: The subject is deleted. It cannot be deleted if it is assigned to any group.

period.title: Delete period {name}
period.description: The period is deleted from the stage.

scale.title: Delete scale {code}
scale.description: The scale and all its values are deleted.

facility.title: Delete facility {code}
facility.description: The facility is deleted from the school. It cannot be deleted if sessions of a year in planning or active use it.

frame.title: Delete timetable frame {name}
frame.description: The frame and all its time slots are deleted. It cannot be deleted if any time slot has sessions.

errors.unexpected: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

periods.title: Academic periods
periods.caption: Academic periods of the stage
periods.empty: This stage has no academic periods
periods.overlapWith: The period overlaps “{name}” in the same stage.

slots.hint: Each time slot is a day of the week and an interval of school hours. The end time is not included: a slot ending at 09:25 and another starting at 09:25 do not overlap.
